subject: [PATCH v3 3/3] btrfs: downgrade the reflink source inode lock for tree walking

reviews.author: Filipe Manana
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the patch description's assumption about writeback timing is outdated, as writeback often happens before locking, and requested no further action.
reviews.raw_body:
This last sentence is a bit outdated, as we very often no longer wait
for the duration of all writeback, since it usually happens before
locking.

Other than that:

Reviewed-by: Filipe Manana <fdmanana@suse.com>

Thanks.

2026-09-17.patch_summary: This patch improves the performance of reflink operations in Btrfs by downgrading the lock on the source inode from exclusive to shared during tree walking. This is done to avoid blocking other shared lock users, such as direct I/O writers and readers, which can cause stalls. The patch also adds a new flag to indicate when an inode is being used as a reflink source, and ensures that this flag is visible to direct I/O writers. Additionally, it remains exclusive for dio reads until the inode_dio_wait() function is finished with its work.
